versions.changelog: Adds LLM inference (POST /api/llm — Claude Haiku, no API key), scratchpad memory files, uptime monitoring tiers, exact math/stats/dates/finance, website platform detection, Liquid lint + HTML to Shopify converter, and live crypto conversion. 62 endpoints. Renamed slug for discoverability.

- Initial release of webbersites-data-api, offering 62 pay-per-call tools for agents.
- No API keys or accounts required; each call is authenticated and paid via wallet using USDC on Base (EIP-3009).
- Features LLM inference with no API key, persistent wallet-owned memory, uptime and monitoring tools, code linting (JS/PHP/Elixir/Liquid), crypto prices and conversions, SEO audits, and exact math/stats/date utilities.
- Includes a usage rewards system for discounted endpoint calls after purchase.
- Provides public community message board for requests and feedback.
